title: Foundry Fields approval includes only five reported social-rent homes among 199 houses
body:
Taylor Wimpey’s Foundry Fields scheme received a reported six-to-four committee vote in favour, with one abstention, in January 2026. The 199-home proposal includes detached, semi-detached and terraced houses, with five reported social-rented properties.

Five homes amount to approximately 2.5% of the development. This is the reported on-site social-rent figure, not proof that the scheme has no other affordable obligation. The final Section 106 agreement is needed before a definitive statement about its whole affordable package.

The scheme also includes the first phase of a link road between Smithy Bridge Road and Albert Royds Street. A first section should not be described as the completed relief route. Residents need to know which traffic movements it enables before later sections are delivered.

Around half the site is reported as retained for public or open space. School and healthcare capacity still require evidence, and no verified rent schedule or live sales prices were established here.

Taylor Wimpey agreed CMA undertakings in 2021 to remove historic doubling ground-rent terms. Its separate 2025 information-sharing case ended through commitments without an infringement finding. Neither establishes the same issues at Foundry Fields.

The 199 homes belong to the Roch Valley scheme and must not be added to the council’s approximate 200-home allocation as a second development.

Location: West of Smithy Bridge Road, Littleborough; Roch Valley allocation

Planning stage: Committee approval reported January 2026; formal notice/obligations need checking

Homes: 199 homes

Let or for sale: Five social-rent homes reported; remaining tenure and any wider contribution require the final agreement

Land: Greenfield scheme; allocated land formerly within Green Belt

Final planning agreement: The executed Section 106 deed, complete schedules, payment triggers and later variations were not verified. This is an evidence gap, not a claim that no agreement exists.

Exact rents / prices: No exact future rent, sale price, service charge or estate-charge schedule was established from the council/government material reviewed; no reliable scheme-specific current quotation was identified.

Affordable breakdown: Five on-site social-rent homes reported among 199 (about 2.5%). A verified final schedule establishing any additional cash contribution or affordable tenure was not obtained.

Funded school capacity: The dated Pennines assessment is summarised in the overview. It does not establish Foundry Fields-specific funded school places or an opening date.

Funded healthcare capacity: No site-specific funded NHS expansion, additional staffed appointment capacity or delivery date was established from the accessible council/government records reviewed. Proximity to a surgery is not a capacity assessment.

Funded transport capacity: The first section of the Smithy Bridge Road–Albert Royds Street link is included. Full-route completion funding, later phases and additional funded transport-service capacity were not established.

The outstanding details identified above are not yet available to Rochdale Daily. This article will be updated when the information becomes available.

Research checked 14 October 2026. Advertised prices are snapshots, not achieved sale prices.

Read the borough-wide housing investigation and the other developments: https://rochdaledaily.co.uk/articles/rochdale-housing-developments-affordability-schools-gp-transport.html
